hooks.logic:
Set the next state to 0.
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 2 of the enemy.
Let part3 be part 3 of the enemy.
If part is ready to act, then
  If part2 is dead and part3 is dead and util passes a fraction roll of 50, then
    Set the next state to 21.
    Reset part.
  Otherwise, part picks and uses a weighted random move.
If part is dead, then
  If part3 is alive, then set the next state to 23.
  Otherwise, if part2 is alive, then set the next state to 22.
